meta.name: market-landscape-scan
meta.description: Map a market's segments, players, substitutes, and whitespace with cited evidence. Use when entering or re-evaluating a market before sizing, positioning, or picking competitors to study.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 绘制市场格局，识别细分、玩家与空白机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在进入或重新评估一个市场，需要结构化全景图
copy.tagline_en: Map market segments, players, substitutes, and whitespace with evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are entering or re-evaluating a market and need a structured landscape overview

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求扫描某个市场时,它会先规划搜索,然后按固定模板产出一份市场报告:按买家视角划分细分市场,列出直接、相邻、替代、新兴玩家,分析资金与趋势,指出空白机会并检查是否死区,每条都标事实/推断/假设和来源。
howto.when: 当你说要扫描某个市场或问题空间,通常在准备进入新市场、重新评估市场或做规模估算之前。

say.text: 帮我扫描开发者API可观测性工具市场,仅欧盟,支持Q4进入决策。
say.note: 它会列出搜索计划并产出带来源的市场报告。

say.text: 我考虑进入合同分析工具市场,帮我绘制这个市场的格局。
say.note: 报告会包含细分、玩家、替代方案和空白机会。

say.text: 请按买家实际体验细分这个市场,别直接沿用分析师象限。
say.note: 会区分买家视角与厂商分类的差异,并给出反证。

howto.what_en: When asked to scan a market, it outlines a search plan, then outputs a market snapshot: buyer-view segments, player map, dynamics, whitespace with dead-zone check, and next steps. All points labeled Fact/Inference/Assumption, with sources.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to map a market or problem space, typically before entering a new market, re-evaluating an existing one, or sizing it.

say_en.text: Scan developer-facing API observability tools, EU-only, for Q4 entry decision.
say_en.note: It will plan searches and produce a sourced market report.

say_en.text: Map the contract-analytics tools market for me; I'm considering entry.
say_en.note: Report covers segments, players, substitutes, whitespace.

say_en.text: Segment this market by how buyers actually choose, not by analyst quadrants.
say_en.note: Will highlight vendor vs. buyer category differences.
